entries.label: GLAD_WHEN_YOU_COME_BACK
entries.body: Hurry back, Captain.
entries.source: Hurry back, Captain.
entries.translation: 快去快回，船長。

entries.label: GIVE_FUEL
entries.body:
We do have a small amount of Starship fuel which is of no use to our power systems.
We will now transport 5 units to your vessel.
entries.source:
We do have a small amount of Starship fuel which is of no use to our power systems.
We will now transport 5 units to your vessel.
entries.translation:
我們確實還有少量星艦燃 料，但我們的動力系統用不 上。
現在會將 5 單位送到你的船上。

entries.label: GIVE_FUEL_AGAIN
entries.body:
We are almost out of fuel now, but we do have a BIT more.
You will have to be more careful with this supply.
Transporting fuel now.
entries.source:
We are almost out of fuel now, but we do have a BIT more.
You will have to be more careful with this supply.
Transporting fuel now.
entries.translation:
我們的燃料幾乎耗盡了， 但確實還有一點點。
這批補給你可得用得更小 心。
現在輸送燃料。

entries.label: ARE_YOU_SUPPLY_SHIP
entries.body:
Attention unidentified space vessel!
I am Starbase Commander Hayes of the slave planet Earth.
our HyperWave broadcasts -- extremely weak
situation critical -- energy cores exhausted
scanners and deep radar are non-functional
we cannot identify your vessel
Are you the scheduled Hierarchy resupply ship?
Repeat, are you the resupply vessel?

I am Starbase Commander Hayes of the slave planet Earth.
our HyperWave broadcasts -- extremely weak
situation critical -- energy cores exhausted
scanners and deep radar are non-functional
we cannot identify your vessel
Are you the scheduled Hierarchy resupply ship?
Repeat, are you the resupply vessel?
entries.translation:
不明太空船請注意！
我是奴隸行星地球星際基地 的海耶斯指揮官。
我們的超波廣播——極度微 弱
情況危急——能源核心耗盡
掃描器與深空雷達無法運作
我們無法識別你的船艦
你是預定抵達的階序補給船 嗎？
重複，你是補給船嗎？

entries.label: DO_YOU_HAVE_RADIO_THIS_TIME
entries.body: Did you find any radioactive elements for our power cores?
entries.source: Did you find any radioactive elements for our power cores?
entries.translation: 你找到供我們動力核心使用 的放射性元素了嗎？

entries.label: HERE_IS_ANOTHER_LANDER
entries.body:
What!!!
You lost another lander!?
We'll build another, but DON'T LOSE THIS ONE, OKAY!
entries.source:
What!!!
You lost another lander!?
We'll build another, but DON'T LOSE THIS ONE, OKAY!
entries.translation:
什麼！！！
你又弄丟一艘登陸艇！？
我們會再造一艘， 但這一艘別再弄丟了， 聽懂沒！

entries.label: HERE_IS_ANOTHER_LANDER_CLEAN
entries.body:
What!!!
You lost another lander!?
We'll build another, but DON'T LOSE THIS ONE, OKAY!
entries.source:
What!!!
You lost another lander!?
We'll build another, but DON'T LOSE THIS ONE, OKAY!
entries.translation:
什麼！！！
你又弄丟一艘登陸艇！？
我們會再造一艘， 但這一艘別再弄丟了， 聽懂沒！

entries.label: THE_WHAT_FROM_WHERE
entries.body:
The starship what?
Never mind -- look, we won't last much longer. Here is our situation
According to our Oath of Fealty to the Ur-Quan, we must maintain this starbase
but, we have no space vessels of our own
and the shield prevents us from contacting Earth
so we are totally dependent on the Ur-Quan supply vessels for everything we need up here.
We know there is a Hierarchy base on the surface of the moon, but we can't contact them.
The Ur-Quan were supposed to resupply the base at regular, five year intervals
but we haven't received anything in almost eight years!
What we don't recycle we can usually synthesize
but to do so, we need replacement radioactives for our generator energy cores.
If you could bring us some radioactive elements, we can fabricate the cores ourselves.
Are you willing to help us!?

entries.translation:
那艘星艦怎麼了？
算了——聽著， 我們撐不了多久。 情況是這樣
根據對烏爾關立下的效忠誓 約，我們必須維持這座星際 基地
但我們沒有自己的太空船
而護盾使我們無法聯絡地球
所以這裡所需的一切， 都得完全仰賴烏爾關補給 船。
我們知道月球表面有一座階 序基地，卻無法聯絡他們。
烏爾關原本應該固定每五年 為基地補給一次
但我們已經快八年沒收到任 何東西了！
無法回收的東西， 我們通常能夠合成
但要這麼做，就需要替發電 機能源核心補充放射性物 質。
如果你能帶些放射性元素 來，我們就能自行製造核 心。
你願意幫我們嗎！？

entries.label: ABOUT_TIME
entries.body:
Well, it's about damn time!
In the Fealty agreement the Ur-Quan promised that this station would be resupplied
at least every five years, and its been over eight since we saw you!
If you had arrived a few weeks later, there wouldn't have been anyone alive on this station
never mind...just begin your transfer of materials immediately, starting with the radioactives.
entries.source:

entries.translation:
該死，總算來了！
烏爾關在效忠協議中承諾， 至少每五年
要為這座太空站補給一次， 但我們已有八年多沒見到你 們了！
如果你再晚幾週抵達， 這座太空站上早就沒有活人 了
算了……立刻開始轉移物 資，先從放射性物質開始。

entries.label: MESSAGE_GARBLED_1
entries.body: I'm sorry, Captain, your message was garbled. Our receivers have very little power.
entries.source: I'm sorry, Captain, your message was garbled. Our receivers have very little power.
entries.translation: 抱歉，船長，你的訊息失真 了。我們的接收器幾乎沒有 電力。

entries.label: MESSAGE_GARBLED_2
entries.body: I couldn't quite make it out, Captain. Could you please repeat?
entries.source: I couldn't quite make it out, Captain. Could you please repeat?
entries.translation: 我沒聽清楚，船長。 請再說一次好嗎？

entries.label: HERE_IS_A_NEW_LANDER
entries.body:
Manufacturing a new lander for you will use most of what little resources we have left
but I suppose we have no choice.
We will transport the new lander vehicle immediately.
entries.source:
Manufacturing a new lander for you will use most of what little resources we have left
but I suppose we have no choice.
We will transport the new lander vehicle immediately.
entries.translation:
替你製造一艘新登陸艇， 會耗掉我們所剩無幾的大部 分資源
但看來也別無選擇。
我們會立刻把新登陸艇送過 去。

entries.label: HERE_IS_A_NEW_LANDER_CLEAN
entries.body:
Manufacturing a new lander for you will use most of what little resources we have left
but I suppose we have no choice.
We will transport the new lander vehicle immediately.
entries.source:

但看來也別無選擇。
我們會立刻把新登陸艇送過 去。

entries.label: THIS_MAY_SEEM_SILLY
entries.body:
By the way Captain, I think we need a name for this new alliance we're going to forge.
And since it was your idea, it's only fair that you get the honor of naming it.
So, what will it be?
entries.source:
By the way Captain, I think we need a name for this new alliance we're going to forge.
And since it was your idea, it's only fair that you get the honor of naming it.
So, what will it be?
entries.translation:
對了，船長，我想我們得替 即將建立的新聯盟取個名 字。
既然主意是你提出的， 由你享有命名的榮譽也很公 平。
那麼，要叫什麼？

entries.label: OK_THE_NAFS
entries.body: Okay, that sounds pretty inspiring. So be it - The New Alliance of Free Stars!
entries.source: Okay, that sounds pretty inspiring. So be it - The New Alliance of Free Stars!
entries.translation: 好，這名字聽起來很振奮人 心。就這麼定了——新自由 星辰聯盟！

entries.label: OK_THE_CAN
entries.body: Very well.  From this day forward, we are The Concordance of Alien Nations!
entries.source: Very well.  From this day forward, we are The Concordance of Alien Nations!
entries.translation: 很好。從今天起， 我們就是外星國族協約！

entries.label: OK_THE_UFW
entries.body: That has a familiar ring to it... nonetheless, we will make it so - The United Federation of Worlds!
entries.source: That has a familiar ring to it... nonetheless, we will make it so - The United Federation of Worlds!
entries.translation: 聽來有點耳熟…… 不過就這麼定了——聯合世 界聯邦！

entries.label: OK_THE_NAME_IS_EMPIRE0
entries.body:
Ulp!  Well... you're the one with the big starship.
So be it - The Empire of
entries.source:
Ulp!  Well... you're the one with the big starship.
So be it - The Empire of
entries.translation:
呃！好吧……有大星艦的人 是你。
就這麼定了——帝國之

entries.label: FUEL_UP0
entries.body:
We are initiating transfer of radioactives, Captain.
Now, as soon as our engineers can refit the energy cores...
entries.source:
We are initiating transfer of radioactives, Captain.
Now, as soon as our engineers can refit the energy cores...
entries.translation:
我們正開始轉移放射性物 質，船長。
現在，只要工程師能重新裝 配能源核心……

entries.label: FUEL_UP1
entries.body:
...there, that's much better. Power ratings are climbing, life support is coming back into the green.
Deep radar systems and sensors are now online and I can scan your vessel.
!!!? -- WHAT THE HELL KIND OF SHIP IS THAT!?
Just who ARE you, Captain?
entries.source:
...there, that's much better. Power ratings are climbing, life support is coming back into the green.
Deep radar systems and sensors are now online and I can scan your vessel.
!!!? -- WHAT THE HELL KIND OF SHIP IS THAT!?
Just who ARE you, Captain?
entries.translation:
……好了，這樣好多了。 功率讀數正在上升， 維生系統也重回綠色安全 區。
深空雷達系統與感測器現已 上線，我可以掃描你的船 了。
！！！？——這到底是什麼 鬼船！？
你究竟是誰，船長？

entries.label: WHAT_KIND_OF_IDIOT
entries.body:
WHAT!
What kind of idiot sent you out here without replacements for our energy cores!?
It's amazing that we've kept the generators online for as long as we have!
Look, you had better get those radioactives right away
or all the other supplies are pretty damn pointless, since we'll all be too dead to use them!

entries.translation:
什麼！
哪個白痴會讓你不帶替換能 源核心就跑來這裡！？
我們竟然能讓發電機運轉到 現在，簡直不可思議！
聽著，你最好立刻弄到那些 放射性物質
不然其他補給品根本毫無意 義，因為我們全都會死到用 不著！

entries.label: DONT_KNOW_WHO_YOU_ARE
entries.body:
Look, I don't know who you are or why you're here
but right now the only thing I'm worried about
is saving the lives of the 1900 men and women aboard this starbase
and right now you're our only hope.
I can't keep the transmitter on too much longer -- we need the power for heat and air
so if you don't have any radioactives on board your vessel
please get some and bring them back here before it's too late.

entries.translation:
聽著，我不知道你是誰， 也不知道你為什麼來
但現在我唯一擔心的
是拯救這座星際基地上 1900 名男女的性命
而你是我們目前唯一的希 望。
我不能讓發射器繼續開太久 ——我們需要電力供暖和供 氣
所以如果你的船上沒有任何 放射性物質
請去找一些，在一切太遲之 前帶回來。

entries.label: THATS_IMPOSSIBLE
entries.body:
Star Control science mission, eh?
Captain, I served as a Star Control officer during the war, aboard several cruisers in the Coreward Front
and if there had been any `scientific mission' to Vela
I would have heard about it.
entries.source:
Star Control science mission, eh?
Captain, I served as a Star Control officer during the war, aboard several cruisers in the Coreward Front
and if there had been any `scientific mission' to Vela
I would have heard about it.
entries.translation:
星際控制的科學任務， 是嗎？
船長，戰爭期間我曾擔任星 際控制軍官，在核心方向前 線的數艘巡洋艦上服役
如果真有任何前往船帆座的 「科學任務」
我一定會聽說。

entries.label: ASK_AWAY
entries.body: Okay, what do you want to know?
entries.source: Okay, what do you want to know?
entries.translation: 好，你想知道什麼？

entries.label: RADIOS_ON_MERCURY
entries.body:
The fastest way to get radioactives in this system would be to land on Mercury
and scour the surface for deposits of radioactive elements.
But be careful. Mercury is a pretty inhospitable place!
Watch out for earthquakes and those high-temperature areas!

entries.translation:
在這個星系取得放射性物質 最快的方法，是降落水星
搜索表面的放射性元素礦 藏。
但要小心。水星是個相當不 適合生存的地方！
提防地震和那些高溫區域！

entries.label: THANKS_FOR_HELPING
entries.body:
Thanks! I'll make sure to mention this the next time I talk with our masters
I'm sure they will reward you.
entries.source:
Thanks! I'll make sure to mention this the next time I talk with our masters
I'm sure they will reward you.
entries.translation:
謝了！下次與我們的主人交 談時，我一定會提到這件事
相信他們會獎賞你。

entries.label: STARBASE_IS
entries.body:
Ur-Quan slave law requires that we maintain an orbital space platform
to assist Hierarchy vessels which are in need of repairs or fuel.
Since the shield around the Earth cuts us off completely from the planet
we are dependent on Ur-Quan resupply ships for our non-renewable resources.
The resupply vessels are supposed to arrive every five years
at which time the Ur-Quan somehow penetrate the shield and exchange those of us up here
with replacement personnel from the surface.

entries.translation:
烏爾關奴隸法要求我們維持 一座軌道太空平臺
協助需要修理或燃料的階序 船艦。
地球周圍的護盾讓我們與行 星完全隔絕
所以不可再生資源全得依賴 烏爾關補給船。
補給船原應每五年抵達一次
屆時烏爾關會以某種方式穿 透護盾，將我們這些駐守人 員
與地表派來的接替人員交 換。

entries.label: HAPPENED_TO_EARTH
entries.body:
When the Alliance lost the war, the Ur-Quan gave Earth a single choice
join the Hierarchy as Battle Thralls and fight for the Ur-Quan to enslave other sentient species
or become `fallow' slaves, and be forever imprisoned on a single world
encased in an impenetrable energy shield here on Earth.
We choose not to fight for the Ur-Quan.

entries.translation:
聯盟戰敗時，烏爾關只給地 球一個選擇
加入階序成為戰奴， 為烏爾關作戰並奴役其他智 慧物種
或成為「休耕」奴隸， 永遠囚禁在單一世界上
被地球這面無法穿透的能量 護盾包圍。
我們選擇不為烏爾關作戰。

entries.label: URQUAN_LEFT
entries.body:
Soon after Earth accepted the Ur-Quan's Oath of Fealty, they departed,
leaving behind a battle group of Spathi and Ilwrath ships based on the moon.
entries.source:
Soon after Earth accepted the Ur-Quan's Oath of Fealty, they departed,
leaving behind a battle group of Spathi and Ilwrath ships based on the moon.
entries.translation:
地球接受烏爾關的效忠誓約 後不久，他們便離開了
留下由斯帕西與伊爾拉斯船 艦組成的戰鬥群， 駐紮在月球。

entries.label: BASE_ON_MOON
entries.body:
Ahh...fight the Ur-Quan! Win back our freedom!
I remember having such thoughts myself...once, a long time ago.
But that was in the first years after the defeat, when it was still terrifying to look up
and see the bloody glow of the pulsating slave shield overhead.
Through day and night we gazed up at the impenetrable wall
as though the sheer power of our hatred would pull it down.
But over the years, I spent so much of my time struggling
down on the surface under the shield and then later up here, trying to keep this station alive
that I'd forgotten what it means to be free... to hate our Ur-Quan Masters! 
And now, here you are, in an alien ship of unknown power,
offering me your assistance to fight against the Hierarchy again, after all these years.
Captain, your offer is intriguing.
It's tempting to think that with your advanced Precursor technology
we can somehow crack Earth's slave shield
and reassemble the Alliance to attack the Hierarchy, and THIS time win the damn war!
But... consider the consequences if we should fail.
The Ur-Quan won't just punish us here on the station.
They will exact a gruesome retribution on the surface below as well.
Before I commit this station to helping you attack the Ur-Quan
and accepting the risk of annihilation if we are defeated
I have to make sure that you and your ship have what it takes to oppose the Hierarchy.
I'll make you a deal.
If you can eliminate the alien base on the moon, and get rid of that threat, at least
I will seriously consider your offer.

entries.translation:
啊……對抗烏爾關！ 奪回我們的自由！
我記得自己也曾有過這種想 法……很久以前。
但那是在戰敗後的最初幾 年，當時抬頭看見
上方脈動的奴役護盾泛著血 紅光芒，仍令人膽寒。
我們日夜凝視那道無法穿透 的牆
彷彿光憑仇恨的力量就能把 它扯下來。
然而多年以來， 我把太多時間花在掙扎求生
先是在護盾下的地表， 後來又到這裡， 努力維持太空站運作
以至於我忘了自由是什麼意 思……忘了憎恨我們的烏爾 關霸主！ 
而如今你來了， 駕著一艘力量不明的外星船 艦
提議在多年後再次協助我對 抗階序。
船長，你的提議很吸引人。
想到憑藉你先進的先驅者科 技
我們或許能設法打破地球的 奴役護盾
重組聯盟攻擊階序， 而且這一次贏下這場該死的 戰爭，確實令人心動！
但是……想想失敗的後果。
烏爾關不會只懲罰太空站上 的我們。
他們也會對下方地表施以殘 酷的報復。
在我承諾讓太空站協助你攻 擊烏爾關
並接受戰敗後遭到殲滅的風 險以前
我必須確定你和你的船確實 有本事對抗階序。
我和你做筆交易。
如果你能消滅月球上的外星 基地，至少先除去那個威脅
我就會認真考慮你的提議。

entries.label: ACKNOWLEDGE_SECRET
entries.body:
Hmmm... you know, come to think of it
there were some rumors that Corridor Nine, the special operations division of Star Control
was directing some hush-hush operation near Androsynth space.
The Vela star system... yes, that would be the right direction
So, Captain... if you say it's true
how do you explain that huge, alien starship you're flying
and why are you here? What do you want from us?
entries.source:
Hmmm... you know, come to think of it
there were some rumors that Corridor Nine, the special operations division of Star Control
was directing some hush-hush operation near Androsynth space.
The Vela star system... yes, that would be the right direction
So, Captain... if you say it's true
how do you explain that huge, alien starship you're flying
and why are you here? What do you want from us?
entries.translation:
嗯……你知道嗎，仔細想想
確實有傳聞說， 星際控制的特種作戰部門 「第九走廊」
正在安德羅辛斯空域附近指 揮某項極機密行動。
船帆座星系……對， 方向確實沒錯
所以，船長…… 如果你說的是真的
要如何解釋自己駕駛的那艘 巨大外星星艦
而你又為何來此？ 想從我們這裡得到什麼？

entries.label: ABOUT_BASE
entries.body:
After the Ur-Quan erected the slave shield around Earth, and established this space station
they decided to leave a contingent of combat ships close to the Earth
to keep watch on our planet and confirm that we were obeying the Ur-Quan slave laws.
I'm certain they're still out there on the surface of the moon
because we can pick up a constant stream of alien broadcasts.
entries.source:
After the Ur-Quan erected the slave shield around Earth, and established this space station
they decided to leave a contingent of combat ships close to the Earth
to keep watch on our planet and confirm that we were obeying the Ur-Quan slave laws.
I'm certain they're still out there on the surface of the moon
because we can pick up a constant stream of alien broadcasts.
entries.translation:
烏爾關在地球周圍架起奴役 護盾並建立這座太空站後
決定在地球附近留下一支戰 鬥船艦分遣隊
監視我們的行星， 確認我們遵守烏爾關奴隸 法。
我確定他們仍在月球表面
因為我們能持續收到外星廣 播。

entries.label: GOOD_LUCK_WITH_BASE
entries.body:
Be careful, Captain.
There are probably a dozen Spathi Eluders and Ilwrath Avengers down there on the lunar surface.
I don't know why they haven't come after you yet
but when they do, you'd better have your weapons armed, and your thrusters burning hot.
entries.source:
Be careful, Captain.
There are probably a dozen Spathi Eluders and Ilwrath Avengers down there on the lunar surface.
I don't know why they haven't come after you yet
but when they do, you'd better have your weapons armed, and your thrusters burning hot.
entries.translation:
小心，船長。
月球表面下方大概有十來艘 斯帕西逃逸艦與伊爾拉斯復 仇艦。
我不知道他們為什麼還沒來 追殺你
但一旦他們出動， 你最好讓武器進入備戰狀 態，推進器全力燃燒。

entries.label: DEALT_WITH_BASE_YET
entries.body: Have you dealt with the base yet?
entries.source: Have you dealt with the base yet?
entries.translation: 你處理掉那座基地了嗎？

entries.label: HERE_COMES_ILWRATH
entries.body:
Captain, listen closely!
Long range sensors show a ship closing on this station, fast!
Our computer identifies it as Ilwrath, Avenger-class.
I think you've got a fight on your hands, Captain.
Your best bet is to wait until you have point bl-nk r-nge
C-pt-in! It's ja-min- ou- s-gn-l!...
entries.source:
Captain, listen closely!
Long range sensors show a ship closing on this station, fast!
Our computer identifies it as Ilwrath, Avenger-class.
I think you've got a fight on your hands, Captain.
Your best bet is to wait until you have point bl-nk r-nge
C-pt-in! It's ja-min- ou- s-gn-l!...
entries.translation:
船長，仔細聽！
長程感測器顯示一艘船正高 速逼近太空站！
電腦識別為伊爾拉斯， 復仇艦級。
船長，我想你免不了一戰。
最好的辦法是等到進入零距 -射-
船-！它正干-我們的訊 -！……

entries.label: VERY_IMPRESSIVE
entries.body:
What a beautiful sight, Captain!
I haven't seen an Avenger blown away like that since the Battle in Draco.
I guess you've shown that you can handle yourself in battle, Captain
so my last reservation about helping you has been dissolved.
I will commit this station to helping free Earth and defeat the Ur-Quan.
We may get our atoms rearranged in the process, but by God, Captain, we're going to try!
So, the obvious first step is to get your Precursor equipment and software over here
so that we can make it work with our ship repair fabricators.
But then what, Captain?
entries.source:
What a beautiful sight, Captain!
I haven't seen an Avenger blown away like that since the Battle in Draco.
I guess you've shown that you can handle yourself in battle, Captain
so my last reservation about helping you has been dissolved.
I will commit this station to helping free Earth and defeat the Ur-Quan.
We may get our atoms rearranged in the process, but by God, Captain, we're going to try!
So, the obvious first step is to get your Precursor equipment and software over here
so that we can make it work with our ship repair fabricators.
But then what, Captain?
entries.translation:
多美的景象啊，船長！
自從天龍座戰役後， 我就沒見過復仇艦被炸成那 樣。
看來你證明了自己有能力應 付戰鬥，船長
所以我對協助你的最後一絲 保留也消除了。
我會讓這座太空站全力協助 解放地球並擊敗烏爾關。
我們可能會在過程中被打得 原子重組，但老天在上， 船長，我們一定要試！
所以顯而易見的第一步， 是把你的先驅者設備與軟體 搬到這裡
好讓它們配合我們的船艦修 理製造器運作。
但接下來呢，船長？

entries.label: IT_WAS_ABANDONED
entries.body:
I'll be darned!
All these years we've been listening to their incoherent broadcasts, and we never even guessed.
entries.source:
I'll be darned!
All these years we've been listening to their incoherent broadcasts, and we never even guessed.
entries.translation:
真是見鬼了！
這些年來，我們一直聽著他 們那些語無倫次的廣播， 卻從沒猜到真相。

entries.label: YOU_REALLY_FOUGHT_BASE
entries.body: You fought them, Captain!?  I hope you didn't suffer serious casualties?
entries.source: You fought them, Captain!?  I hope you didn't suffer serious casualties?
entries.translation: 你和他們交戰了，船長！？ 希望你沒有嚴重傷亡？

entries.label: IM_GLAD_YOU_WON
entries.body: I'm delighted to hear it, Captain.  I wish I could have been there.
entries.source: I'm delighted to hear it, Captain.  I wish I could have been there.
entries.translation: 很高興聽你這麼說，船長。 真希望當時我也在場。

entries.label: IM_SURE_IT_WAS_DIFFICULT
entries.body: I'm sure the experience was disturbing.
entries.source: I'm sure the experience was disturbing.
entries.translation: 那次經歷想必令人不安。

entries.label: THAT_WAS_PROBE
entries.body:
That was the Ur-Quan Security Drone. It keeps an eye on us.
Captain, what happened to the spy drone!?
entries.source:
That was the Ur-Quan Security Drone. It keeps an eye on us.
Captain, what happened to the spy drone!?
entries.translation:
那是烏爾關保安無人機， 負責監視我們。
船長，那架間諜無人機怎麼 了！？

entries.label: DEEP_TROUBLE
entries.body:
Oh no. Right now it's probably cruising through HyperSpace
heading right towards the closest Hierarchy outpost.
When the Ur-Quan find out that you are here, they will send a combat fleet instantly!
entries.source:
Oh no. Right now it's probably cruising through HyperSpace
heading right towards the closest Hierarchy outpost.
When the Ur-Quan find out that you are here, they will send a combat fleet instantly!
entries.translation:
糟了。它現在大概正在超空 間巡航
直奔最近的階序前哨站。
烏爾關一旦得知你在這裡， 立刻就會派出戰鬥艦隊！

entries.label: GOOD_NEWS
entries.body:
Whew!  That was a close one.  If that probe had gotten away -- up into HyperSpace
we'd be up to our ears in Dreadnoughts in no time.
What a relief!
entries.source:
Whew!  That was a close one.  If that probe had gotten away -- up into HyperSpace
we'd be up to our ears in Dreadnoughts in no time.
What a relief!
entries.translation:
呼！真是千鈞一髮。 如果那架探測器逃進超空間
用不了多久，我們就會被無 畏艦淹沒。
總算可以鬆口氣了！

entries.label: SURE_HOPE
entries.body: If that probe gets back to the Ur-Quan, Captain, we are BOTH in deep trouble!
entries.source: If that probe gets back to the Ur-Quan, Captain, we are BOTH in deep trouble!
entries.translation: 船長，如果那架探測器回到 烏爾關那裡，我們兩邊都會 有大麻煩！

entries.label: ABOUT_BASE_AGAIN
entries.body:
As I said before, after the Ur-Quan erected the slave shield around the Earth and assembled this space station
they decided to leave a contingent of Spathi and Ilwrath ships stationed on the moon.
We have looked at the moonbase through our telescopes and can confirm that there is still substantial activity down there
but we have never been able to make contact with the base using either HyperWave `Caster
or traditional radio signals.
entries.source:
As I said before, after the Ur-Quan erected the slave shield around the Earth and assembled this space station
they decided to leave a contingent of Spathi and Ilwrath ships stationed on the moon.
We have looked at the moonbase through our telescopes and can confirm that there is still substantial activity down there
but we have never been able to make contact with the base using either HyperWave `Caster
or traditional radio signals.
entries.translation:
如我先前所說， 烏爾關在地球周圍架起奴役 護盾並組裝這座太空站後
決定把一支斯帕西與伊爾拉 斯船艦分遣隊駐紮在月球。
我們曾用望遠鏡觀察月球基 地，能確認下方仍有相當頻 繁的活動
但我們無論用超波發射器
或傳統無線電訊號， 都始終無法與基地取得聯 絡。

entries.label: COOK_BUTTS
entries.body: Ha-ha.. yes, Captain, we'll do just that!
entries.source: Ha-ha.. yes, Captain, we'll do just that!
entries.translation: 哈、哈……對，船長， 我們就這麼辦！

entries.label: OVERTHROW_ALIENS
entries.body: If you feel it's necessary Captain, I understand.
entries.source: If you feel it's necessary Captain, I understand.
entries.translation: 如果你認為有必要， 我能理解，船長。

entries.label: KILL_MONSTERS
entries.body: A sensible plan, Captain.  Let's get to work.
entries.source: A sensible plan, Captain.  Let's get to work.
entries.translation: 很合理的計畫，船長。 我們開始工作吧。

entries.label: GOOD_LUCK_AGAIN
entries.body: Hurry back, Captain.
entries.source: Hurry back, Captain.
entries.translation: 快去快回，船長。

entries.label: STARBASE_WILL_BE_READY
entries.body:
Now Captain, I expect the configuration process for the starbase
to take at least 2 weeks, so let's get to work...
entries.source:
Now Captain, I expect the configuration process for the starbase
to take at least 2 weeks, so let's get to work...
entries.translation:
船長，我預計星際基地的配 置作業
至少需要兩週， 所以開始工作吧……

entries.label: overthrow_evil_aliens
entries.body: Er... trust me Commander, I have a plan... a really good plan!  But for now it must remain a secret.
entries.source: Er... trust me Commander, I have a plan... a really good plan!  But for now it must remain a secret.
entries.translation: 呃……相信我，指揮官， 我有個計畫…… 非常好的計畫！ 但目前必須保密。

entries.label: annihilate_those_monsters
entries.body: We will slowly build our strength, unify an allied starfleet, and bring the Ur-Quan to their knee-equivalents.
entries.source: We will slowly build our strength, unify an allied starfleet, and bring the Ur-Quan to their knee-equivalents.
entries.translation: 我們會逐步壯大實力， 統一盟軍星際艦隊， 讓烏爾關跪下——或用他們 相當於膝蓋的部位跪下。

entries.label: cook_their_butts
entries.body: Then, Commander, we will proceed to kick some major alien butt!
entries.source: Then, Commander, we will proceed to kick some major alien butt!
entries.translation: 然後，指揮官， 我們就去狠狠痛扁外星人！

entries.label: where_get_radios
entries.body: Where can we acquire radioactives?
entries.source: Where can we acquire radioactives?
entries.translation: 我們可以到哪裡取得放射性 物質？

entries.label: well_go_get_them_now
entries.body: We will leave now and bring back the elements you require.
entries.source: We will leave now and bring back the elements you require.
entries.translation: 我們現在就出發， 把你需要的元素帶回來。

entries.label: we_will_transfer_now
entries.body: We are ready to transfer radioactives.
entries.source: We are ready to transfer radioactives.
entries.translation: 我們已準備好轉移放射性物 質。

entries.label: what_will_you_give_us
entries.body: What will you give us in exchange for radioactives?
entries.source: What will you give us in exchange for radioactives?
entries.translation: 你會用什麼交換放射性物 質？

entries.label: before_radios_we_need_info
entries.body: Before we help you, we require certain information.
entries.source: Before we help you, we require certain information.
entries.translation: 幫助你之前，我們需要一些 情報。

entries.label: no_but_well_help0
entries.body: No, this is the starship
entries.source: No, this is the starship
entries.translation: 不，這艘星艦是

entries.label: no_but_well_help1
entries.body: , but we stand ready to assist you.
entries.source: , but we stand ready to assist you.
entries.translation: ，但我們隨時準備協助你。

entries.label: yes_this_is_supply_ship
entries.body: Uh.. yes, this IS the resupply vessel. What do you need resupplied?
entries.source: Uh.. yes, this IS the resupply vessel. What do you need resupplied?
entries.translation: 呃……對，這的確是補給 船。你們需要補給什麼？

entries.label: what_slave_planet
entries.body: `Slave planet!' `Hierarchy resupply vessel!'  What is going on here?
entries.source: `Slave planet!' `Hierarchy resupply vessel!'  What is going on here?
entries.translation: 「奴隸行星！」「階序補給 船！」這裡究竟發生了什麼 事？

entries.label: i_lied
entries.body: Actually I lied, this isn't the resupply vessel. Sorry.
entries.source: Actually I lied, this isn't the resupply vessel. Sorry.
entries.translation: 其實我撒了謊， 這不是補給船。抱歉。

entries.label: plumb_out
entries.body: Er..., oh dang!  Wouldn't you know it; we're plumb out of those.
entries.source: Er..., oh dang!  Wouldn't you know it; we're plumb out of those.
entries.translation: 呃……喔，該死！ 偏偏就這麼巧， 我們那些東西剛好用光了。

entries.label: we_are_vindicator0
entries.body: I am Captain
entries.source: I am Captain
entries.translation: 我是船長

entries.label: we_are_vindicator1
entries.body: of the starship
entries.source: of the starship
entries.translation: ，隸屬於星艦

entries.label: we_are_vindicator2
entries.body: . We are the survivors of a Star Control science research team to the Vela star system.
entries.source: . We are the survivors of a Star Control science research team to the Vela star system.
entries.translation: 。我們是前往船帆座星系的 星際控制科學研究隊倖存 者。

entries.label: first_give_info
entries.body: I need you to explain a few things.
entries.source: I need you to explain a few things.
entries.translation: 我需要你解釋幾件事。

entries.label: we_must_go_now
entries.body: We must leave now. I shall tell you more when we return.
entries.source: We must leave now. I shall tell you more when we return.
entries.translation: 我們現在必須離開。 回來後，我會告訴你更多。

entries.label: where_can_i_get_radios
entries.body: Where can we find the radioactive elements you need?
entries.source: Where can we find the radioactive elements you need?
entries.translation: 我們可以到哪裡找到你需要 的放射性元素？

entries.label: ok_i_will_get_radios
entries.body: We will leave now to find the elements you require.
entries.source: We will leave now to find the elements you require.
entries.translation: 我們現在就出發尋找你需要 的元素。

entries.label: whats_this_starbase
entries.body: To begin with, what is the purpose of this starbase?
entries.source: To begin with, what is the purpose of this starbase?
entries.translation: 首先，這座星際基地有什麼 用途？

entries.label: what_about_earth
entries.body: What is that strange red glow around Earth?
entries.source: What is that strange red glow around Earth?
entries.translation: 地球周圍那股奇怪的紅光是 什麼？

entries.label: where_are_urquan
entries.body: Where are the Ur-Quan now?
entries.source: Where are the Ur-Quan now?
entries.translation: 烏爾關現在在哪裡？

entries.label: our_mission_was_secret
entries.body: The mission was highly secret.
entries.source: The mission was highly secret.
entries.translation: 那項任務是最高機密。

entries.label: we_are_here_to_help
entries.body: We have returned to Earth to give you the technological secrets of the Precursors, and to help you fight the Hierarchy.
entries.source: We have returned to Earth to give you the technological secrets of the Precursors, and to help you fight the Hierarchy.
entries.translation: 我們返回地球， 是要把先驅者的科技祕密交 給你，並協助你對抗階序。

entries.label: tell_me_about_base
entries.body: What details can you give us about the base on the moon?
entries.source: What details can you give us about the base on the moon?
entries.translation: 關於月球上的基地， 你能提供哪些細節？

entries.label: we_will_take_care_of_base
entries.body: We shall go now and neutralize the base.
entries.source: We shall go now and neutralize the base.
entries.translation: 我們現在就去癱瘓那座基 地。

entries.label: tell_me_again
entries.body: Could you tell me again about the Hierarchy base on the moon?
entries.source: Could you tell me again about the Hierarchy base on the moon?
entries.translation: 你能再告訴我一次月球上那 座階序基地的事嗎？

entries.label: base_was_abandoned
entries.body: We found the base, but it was abandoned years ago.
entries.source: We found the base, but it was abandoned years ago.
entries.translation: 我們找到那座基地了， 但它多年前就已廢棄。

entries.label: we_fought_them
entries.body: We, uh... attacked the moonbase, and completely destroyed the enemy!
entries.source: We, uh... attacked the moonbase, and completely destroyed the enemy!
entries.translation: 我們，呃……攻擊了月球基 地，徹底消滅敵人！

entries.label: oh_yes_big_fight
entries.body: Er... oh, yes! It was a very vicious fight.
entries.source: Er... oh, yes! It was a very vicious fight.
entries.translation: 呃……喔，對！ 那是一場非常慘烈的戰鬥。

entries.label: i_lied_it_was_abandoned
entries.body: Actually I lied. We found it abandoned.
entries.source: Actually I lied. We found it abandoned.
entries.translation: 其實我撒謊了。 我們發現基地早已廢棄。

entries.label: i_cant_talk_about_it
entries.body: It was too horrible for words. I just can't talk about it right now.
entries.source: It was too horrible for words. I just can't talk about it right now.
entries.translation: 那實在慘不忍言。 我現在完全說不出口。

entries.label: name_1
entries.body: The New Alliance of Free Stars!
entries.source: The New Alliance of Free Stars!
entries.translation: 新自由星辰聯盟！

entries.label: name_2
entries.body: The Concordance of Alien Nations!
entries.source: The Concordance of Alien Nations!
entries.translation: 外星國族協約！

entries.label: name_3
entries.body: The United Federation of Worlds!
entries.source: The United Federation of Worlds!
entries.translation: 聯合世界聯邦！

entries.label: name_40
entries.body: The Empire of
entries.source: The Empire of
entries.translation: 帝國之

entries.label: i_lost_my_lander
entries.body: Due to circumstances beyond our control, our only landing vehicle was destroyed.  Can you replace it?
entries.source: Due to circumstances beyond our control, our only landing vehicle was destroyed.  Can you replace it?
entries.translation: 由於無法控制的情況， 我們唯一的登陸艇被摧毀 了。你能補一艘嗎？

entries.label: i_lost_another_lander
entries.body: Um... er... well... We lost another lander.
entries.source: Um... er... well... We lost another lander.
entries.translation: 嗯……呃……這個…… 我們又弄丟一艘登陸艇。

entries.label: need_fuel_mercury
entries.body: We are unable to land on Mercury and retrieve radioactives due to an unforeseen fuel shortage.
entries.source: We are unable to land on Mercury and retrieve radioactives due to an unforeseen fuel shortage.
entries.translation: 由於意外的燃料短缺， 我們無法降落水星取回放射 性物質。

entries.label: need_fuel_luna
entries.body: We are unable to land on the moon and neutralize the base due to an unforeseen fuel shortage.
entries.source: We are unable to land on the moon and neutralize the base due to an unforeseen fuel shortage.
entries.translation: 由於意外的燃料短缺， 我們無法降落月球並癱瘓那 座基地。

entries.label: need_fuel_again
entries.body: Boy, mileage sure does vary. Could you spare us some more fuel?
entries.source: Boy, mileage sure does vary. Could you spare us some more fuel?
entries.translation: 天啊，耗油量還真不一定。 能再分我們一點燃料嗎？

entries.label: what_was_red_thing
entries.body: Commander, what was that red, fast-moving object in orbit around Earth?
entries.source: Commander, what was that red, fast-moving object in orbit around Earth?
entries.translation: 指揮官，剛才地球軌道上那 個高速移動的紅色物體是什 麼？

entries.label: it_went_away
entries.body: When we approached, it transmitted a warning and warped into HyperSpace.
entries.source: When we approached, it transmitted a warning and warped into HyperSpace.
entries.translation: 我們接近時，它發出警告並 躍遷進超空間。

entries.label: we_destroyed_it
entries.body: Er... we destroyed it! Yessiree, blew it to bits.
entries.source: Er... we destroyed it! Yessiree, blew it to bits.
entries.translation: 呃……我們摧毀它了！ 是啊先生，把它炸成了碎 片。

entries.label: what_probe
entries.body: Uh, I meant a different red thing. Never mind.
entries.source: Uh, I meant a different red thing. Never mind.
